text: ZX81 WEATHER WALL 16 SEP 00:07Z: HIGH 30C DILI; LOW 8C MOSCOW. TROPICS QUIET. SEAS ROUGH NEAR S PACIFIC. 100 ZX81S ON WATCH.

image.alt: A 10x10 wall of 100 ZX81 screens rendering a live world weather map in 1-bit block graphics. No cyclones active. Precipitation signals present: rain areas and snow or wintry areas. Hottest 30C at INDONESIA, coldest 8C at W RUSSIA. Roughest seas at S PACIFIC.
